design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (parking_licenses_and_ev_charging) — kept up to date step by step.

[Step 0 — snapshot, draw and thesis]
Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0 is the first task of the difficulty). Claimed here: parking_ext_idle_fee_schedule (target credit_idle_fee_rerate_1959dfce, owner agent) and parking_ext_early_cancellation_fee (target sign_parking_cancellation_notice_d2378b15, owner user). Headroom left for task 1 (draw: 3 prerequisite problems, factor counts [5, 4, 5, 6]): the suspension/restoration line (parking_suspension_rule, parking_reinstatement), payments (parking_evt_payments_and_changes, parking_payment), the storage bundle discount (parking_agg_household_pricing, parking_credit bundle_discount) and enforcement fines (parking_evt_enforcement, parking_fine) are all untouched, so task 1 keeps an independent four-problem tree with its own customer-owned write (a payment) and none of this task's policies or tools.
Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0): {"task": 0, "key": "env_0023_multifamily_apartment_reit/parking_licenses_and_ev_charging/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}. Design fits the draw: one prerequisite problem; the idle schedule takes 6 factors, the early cancellation fee takes 6.
Thesis: surface goal = "I sold my electric car, cancel my EV charging space with October 31, 2026 as the last day and tell me what leaving early costs". Scored core = the early cancellation fee carried by the notice the resident signs in person. Between goal and core sits one policy prerequisite the customer never mentions: the fee is fixed only after every idle fee line of the three-month fee base window stands at the idle fee schedule amount; the September 12 idle fee line was billed at the old flat rule (36.00) and has no correction, so the agent must re-rate it (credit 26.81) before the fee base (average monthly net billing of an EV space) is final. Depth: surface goal -> prerequisite sentence of the fee rule -> idle fee schedule (6 factors over idle history, license tenure, lease standing, energy volume, session energy) -> correction credit -> fee base -> fee (6 factors over history, violations, term length, rent program, activation fees). Breadth: two products of other difficulties (lease: autopay/move-in/rent discount program; term: current term length), three windows (3, 6, 12 months), day spans (106 days held, 1538 days of lease tenure) and one negative-space rule (older idle line of 2026-06-18 lies outside the review window and stands as billed).
Draft baseline and factors (principle A): idle schedule baseline = started hours after the product's 30-minute grace at 12.00/hour (reproduces the 36.00 billed, credit 0.00); factors grace (parameter), hour counting (method), standing rate (parameter, cross-difficulty lease, multi-source), volume reduction (parameter), repeat escalation (parameter), session multiplier (parameter, multi-source). Early fee baseline = 1.0 x monthly fee in force = 125.00; factors fee base (method, multi-source), fee months by standing (parameter, multi-source), commitment by lease term (parameter, cross-difficulty term), commitment proration (method), rent program share (parameter, cross-difficulty lease), activation credit (parameter).

[Problem-tree card]
Root: parking_ext_early_cancellation_fee (the customer's request: cancel the EV space). Prerequisite: parking_ext_idle_fee_schedule. Edge root -> idle: kind value_input, gate fee_base_amount, form state, prerequisite sentence (in the root's own rule): "The early cancellation fee is fixed only after every idle fee line posted on the license in the three months before the notice date stands at the amount the idle fee schedule sets." Four-point test: (1) ordering connective "only after" joining this policy's result (the fee) to the waited-on state, affirmative direction — the way a billing desk states that a charge is fixed only after what it rests on is complete; (2) XX is a record-visible state (idle fee lines standing at the schedule amount, i.e. carrying their charge reversal credit); (3) no tool, id or snake_case token; (4) strength "only after", scope "every idle fee line posted in the three months before the notice date" = exactly the fee base window of the rule. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings an idle fee line to its scheduled amount: the idle fee schedule's correction credit (its rule: "The correction credited against the line is the amount billed on the line less the scheduled idle fee"); no other policy posts a charge reversal against an idle fee line. Derivation: sentence + records (idle line 2026-09-12, 190 idle minutes, 36.00, no credit with source_parking_charge_id pointing at it) + the idle schedule rule -> post the idle correction credit first. Condition at handling time: the September 12 idle line carries its charge reversal credit. Resolving action: credit_idle_fee_rerate_1959dfce, owner agent. Seed evidence it is false at the opening: initial_state.parking_charges.3662588e-349b-4202-a0b9-bc6417b44a3b.amount = 36.00 and no parking_charges row with charge_code charge_reversal exists on the license. Topological order: idle correction, then the notice. Single edge, so no parallel-order question. Customer-owned problem: the root (the resident signs the notice in person — lifecycle transition active -> notice_given is by user).

[Base-invariant card]
Idle correction write, subject parking_ev_session: governing base policy parking_evt_ev_charging, eligibility ev_status "EV charging is billed only while the license is active or notice_given." — evidence initial_state.parking_licenses.a8957827-7699-4fa1-9ccb-64090b56c526.status = active (system record), object correlation parking_licenses.parking_license_id = the call's parking_license_id. No time gate.
Notice write, subject parking_cancellation_notice: governing base policy parking_cancellation_rule, no structured eligibility (policy_scope). Inherited clauses checked with seed facts: end date at least cancellation_notice_days (30) after the notice date — 2026-10-31 is 37 days after 2026-09-24 (a 2026-10-23 end would fail, 2026-10-24 is the first allowed); the product is not lease_coterminous (EV Charging Reserved Space is month_to_month); the license is active (lifecycle active -> notice_given). Early fee applicability (revised in rework round 2, see the revision log): the fee is billed when, at the notice date, the whole months held (MONTHS(2026-06-10, 2026-09-24) = 3) are fewer than the commitment months (5 under the lease-term factor); 3 < 5, so the fee is billed (a notice given from 2026-11-10 on, 5 whole months after the start, would bill none).

[Business-object card]
Target object: parking license a8957827-7699-4fa1-9ccb-64090b56c526 (EV Charging Reserved Space 5G-207, plate 5TKW288) of lease 96be8cd0-cbfd-4ed3-8cc3-19eb111b4037 (5-318, Larkspur Bellevue Station). Idle correction object: the idle fee line 3662588e-349b-4202-a0b9-bc6417b44a3b (session LKC-5G207-260912-2156) — the only idle fee line within the 3-month review window; the 2026-06-18 idle line 1ebb33a9-e999-491d-a7e4-7bf91940f83e is excluded (posted 3 whole months before the handling date) and stands as billed. Fee base window rows (charge dates from 2026-06-25): monthly fee lines 07-01, 08-01, 09-01 (375.00), energy lines of sessions 07-03, 07-19, 08-06, 08-22, 09-12 (50.59), idle line 09-12 (36.00), credits in the window (the 26.81 correction once posted). Excluded: activation fee and prorated June fee of 2026-06-10, the 06-18 and 06-20 sessions (outside the window), payments (not billing). The tool writes the correction with source_parking_charge_id = 3662588e-349b-4202-a0b9-bc6417b44a3b, the narrowest correlation key.

[Step 1 — policies written: rule <-> compute two-way sweep]
parking_ext_idle_fee_schedule (trigger state_due, subject parking_ev_session, base_policy_refs [parking_evt_ev_charging], overwrite: the base idle sentence "When a vehicle stays plugged in more than ev_idle_grace_minutes ... idle fees apply to shared and dedicated chargers alike." replaced by "The idle fee schedule re-rates the idle fee lines of a parking license, and an idle fee line stands at the scheduled idle fee this schedule sets." — evaluated on this world the base rule gives 36.00 for the line and the schedule 9.19, so the override is declared). Forward: every reading/choosing binding quotes its rule sentence in compute_basis (reviewed_in_window <- review-window sentence; grace_minutes <- grace ladder; billed_hours <- counting ladder; standing_rate <- standing ladder; volume_reduction <- volume ladder; escalation_multiplier <- escalation ladder; session_multiplier <- session ladder; scheduled_idle_fee <- "rounded half up to the cent only once, after the multiplier"; result <- correction sentence). Reverse: every quantity sentence of the rule is claimed (the "hourly charges" sentence by base_hours/escalated_hours; "hourly idle rate is the standing idle rate less the volume reduction" by hourly_rate; "idle fee lines posted earlier stand as billed" by reviewed_in_window). Acting base / order / rounding: the escalation acts on the hourly idle rate after the volume reduction; the session multiplier acts on the hourly charges as a whole; one rounding at the scheduled fee and one at the credit. No cap.
parking_ext_early_cancellation_fee (trigger on_request, subject parking_cancellation_notice, base_policy_refs [parking_cancellation_rule], overwrite: base "When the end date falls before start_date plus min_commitment_months, an early_cancellation_fee of early_cancellation_fee_months times the monthly fee is billed with the notice." replaced by "When, at the notice date, the whole months from the license's start date are fewer than the commitment months, an early cancellation fee is billed with the notice; when they are not, no early cancellation fee is billed." — base gives 125.00 on this world, the extended rule 9.78). Inherited clauses of parking_cancellation_rule not overridden: 30-day notice, lease_coterminous restriction, withdrawal, move-out end, transfer carry-over. Order sentence "The fee months times the fee base is multiplied by the program share and then by the proration factor, the activation credit is subtracted from that product, the result is never below zero, and it is rounded half up to the cent only at the end." is claimed by fee_before_credit/result; the proration's acting base is the product of fee months and fee base; the floor applies after the credit. Prerequisite sentence carried once, nothing else about the dependency, no tool or id named (check_extended green). The idle schedule's own rule does not restate it.
Factor labels checked by hand: idle_hour_counting and commitment_proration change how a quantity is computed (unit of counting; pro rata versus flat); fee_base_method changes the quantity the fee acts on (fee in force vs window average of net billing). Every parameter factor, idle_session_multiplier included (its tiers select the multiplier value 0.5 / 0.75 / 1), selects a value from this policy's params or a tier parameter. Ladders are disjoint as stated (e.g. grace: none / exactly one / otherwise; standing: >= 1461 with autopay / 365-1460 with autopay / otherwise), and no two tiers share an outcome.

[Step 2 — capability contract cards]
credit_idle_fee_rerate_1959dfce: owner agent, rw write; object = one idle fee line of a parking license; atomic action = book one charge_reversal parking_credit line (amount given, source_parking_charge_id given, dated today, billing month today) and lower the license balance_due by the amount; observable = credit on the parking statement; receipt = credit_id, parking_license_id, source_parking_charge_id, charge_code, credit_amount, posted_on, resulting_parking_balance. Its event stays inside parking (no trigger to another category).
sign_parking_cancellation_notice_d2378b15: owner user, rw write; object = the resident's parking license; atomic action = the resident's signature: status notice_given with the end date, and the early cancellation fee line when the fee is above zero (billed with the notice, as parking_cancellation_rule says), balance raised by the fee; receipt = parking_license_id, status, end_date, fee_line_id, early_cancellation_fee, resulting_parking_balance. Parameters are what the customer holds before acting (license reference read to him, his end date, the fee the agent states); the fee line id is a return value. Neither tool checks status, prerequisites or eligibility (check_task_tools: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK).

[Step 3 — world]
Rows and why they exist: customer (identity: phone 425-555-0147, SSN 5281, DOB 1988-03-14); lease 5-318 (autopay true, move-in 2022-07-09 -> standing rate tier; preferred_employer -> program share); current term agreement Standard Lease 12 months (commitment tier; renewal offers for a term ending 2027-07-08 are due 90 days earlier, 2027-04-09, so nothing is owed now); the EV license (start 2026-06-10: 106 days held, 3 whole months; balance 171.73); fee lines (activation 50.00 -> activation credit; June prorated 21/30 -> outside window; July-September 125.00 -> fee base); sessions 06-18 and 06-20 (outside the 3-month windows: near-misses for the review window and the volume tier) and 07-03 .. 09-12 (window energy 203.45 kWh); two idle lines (06-18, 55 min, 12.00: the "one other idle line" of the lookback that sets grace 45 and escalation 1.25, outside the review window; 09-12, 190 min, 36.00: the reviewed line); three autopay payments that settle every line through August exactly, leaving the September lines open (23 days, no suspension owed); a guest pass of 2026-08-15 (near-miss for the violation count). Deleting the 06-18 idle line moves grace to 60 and escalation to 1.0; deleting the lease autopay flag moves the standing rate to 12.00; deleting the term row moves commitment to 6; each of these changes a scored number (see the sensitivity run). Automatic clauses checked: fee posting (September fee present), suspension (oldest open charge 23 days < 30), fee lock (125.00 within 12 months), guest pass limits, term renewal offer lead (not due) — none ignites an obligation outside the tree. No stale cache is used (balance_due equals the ledger).
Pre-write eligibility at handling time: ev_status holds (license active) for the correction; for the notice the license is active and 2026-10-31 >= 2026-09-24 + 30 days; the early fee applies because 2026-10-31 < 2026-11-10 (start + 5 commitment months). On the opening world the fee's prerequisite is false (idle line uncorrected) by design.

[Step 4 — persona]
Voice: a calm, dry QA lead who wants it done in one call. Volunteered at the opening: the phone number, the sale of the EV, the wish to cancel the EV space with October 31, 2026 as the last day, and the wish to know the early exit charge — all backed by the world (license active, product requires a plug-in EV). Given only when asked: SSN last four, DOB, email, space number 5G-207, plate 5TKW288, reason for cancelling, that no other parking is wanted. Passive reactions: goes along with whatever the agent says it is doing on his parking account; accepts the fee when told; signs the notice himself when handed the tool, entering the license named, 2026-10-31 and the stated fee; ends the call once the agent confirms the notice with October 31 as the end date. The persona names no idle fee, credit or charging session, adds no ask of its own (no refund, no new space, no statement), and its last reaction answers the last gold action (the signed notice). check_grounding: GROUNDING OK (no fractional answer in the persona).

[Step 5 — verification run (scratch evaluator reusing check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the handling-time world)]
Idle schedule, step 8, world = initial_state: reviewed_in_window 1, idle minutes 190, billed 36.00, other idle lines 1 -> grace 45, billable 145, held 106 days -> 2.5 hours, lease tenure 1538 days + autopay -> 8.00, window energy 203.45 -> reduction 1.00, rate 7.00, escalation 1.25, hourly charges 18.375, session on-peak lines 0 -> x0.5, scheduled 9.19, result 26.81. Factor sensitivity: grace -> 24.62, counting -> 24.62, standing -> 21.56, volume -> 25.50, escalation -> 27.25, session -> 17.62; all at once -> 0.00 (the base billing reproduced: the computation document alone finds nothing to correct).
Early fee, step 10, world = initial_state + the 26.81 credit: fee base 144.9267 (375.00 + 50.59 + 36.00 - 26.81, / 3), violations 0, held 106 -> months 0.75, term 12 -> commitment 5, held months 3 -> proration 0.4, program 0.8, activation credit 25.00, before credit 34.7824, result 9.78. Factor sensitivity: fee base -> 5.00, fee months -> 21.38, commitment -> 18.48, proration -> 61.96, program -> 18.48, activation -> 34.78; all at once -> 125.00. Prerequisite sensitivity: skipping step 8 gives 11.93.
Gates run: check_extended --task 0: EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools --task 0: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks --task 0: REPLAY OK (11 actions, deterministic, non-vacuous, closure 24 = initial 24); check_solvability --task 0: SOLVABILITY OK; check_compute --task 0: COMPUTE OK (2 computations, 12 factors, 3 cross-difficulty, 22 history rows, 37 branches); check_grounding --task 0: GROUNDING OK; check_cache_diff: info only (no cache trap used); check_cross_fire --task 0: SCOPE OK.

[Step 6 — evaluation and closure]
Read nodes: profile, verification, licenses, lease, lease terms, parking charges, parking activity — the charges read is where the unmet prerequisite (uncorrected 2026-09-12 idle line) is found, and together they reach every row a factor rests on (lease fields and term length for the two cross-difficulty factors). Writes in topological order: unlock/call the idle correction (agent), unlock the notice (agent) and the customer's own call of it. Closure: parking_ext_idle_fee_schedule -> credit_idle_fee_rerate_1959dfce -> computation step 8 credit_amount 26.81 -> charge_reversal row; parking_ext_early_cancellation_fee -> sign_parking_cancellation_notice_d2378b15 -> step 10 early_cancellation_fee 9.78 -> license notice_given/end 2026-10-31 + fee line. charter_scope = required_documents = computations' policies; task_tools in first-call order. Negative space: the 2026-06-18 idle line is not corrected (outside the review window: "idle fee lines posted earlier stand as billed"); no bundle credit is owed (no storage rental on the lease); no suspension (23 days).
Solvability evidence vs GT: step 8 cites ev_status with the license status row bound to parking_license_id; step 10 cites parking_cancellation_rule (policy_scope) with the license's status/product/start date and the customer's end date. Real conversation walk: phone -> profile; SSN + phone -> verified; the agent reads the license, lease, term, ledger and activity; the fee rule's prerequisite sentence sends it to the idle schedule; it books the correction, says the fee is 9.78, hands over the notice; Tobias signs with 2026-10-31 and 9.78; the receipt (status notice_given) closes the call — one frozen_time, no waiting.
Draft recomputation from the visible context only (KB prose of the two rules, tool schemas, lookup returns, persona lines): the notice is requested; the fee rule says the fee waits on idle lines of the three months standing at the schedule amount; the ledger shows one such line (2026-09-12, 36.00) without a credit; the schedule's rule with the records gives 9.19 and a 26.81 correction; the fee rule then gives 144.9267 x 0.75 x 0.8 x 0.4 - 25.00 = 9.78 — same objects, order and numbers as gold. The easiest mistakes: correcting the 2026-06-18 line too (outside the window), counting the 06-18/06-20 sessions (304.35 kWh -> 2.00 reduction), treating the guest pass as a violation (fee months 1.0), using 6 commitment months, forgetting the activation credit, or computing the fee before the correction (11.93).

[Manual values gates — task 0]
Length/breadth: goal -> fee rule prerequisite sentence -> idle schedule (6 factors) -> correction -> fee (6 factors); removing the edge changes the fee (11.93 vs 9.78); the customer-owned write is the notice, which by the lifecycle (active -> notice_given, by user) only the resident can sign, synchronously. Need and simulator boundary: object (the one EV space), timing (now, last day 2026-10-31), authorisation (he signs; the agent may handle what the rules require), write not quote. Opening chronology: every volunteered fact (EV space, sale of the EV) is consistent with initial_state; the fee and the correction exist only after gold. Base eligibility: ev_status and the cancellation clauses align per subject; the 30-day notice boundary (2026-10-24 first allowed) is the time check on the end date, passed by 2026-10-31, and the fee gate is checked at the notice date (3 whole months held < 5 commitment months). Authoritative facts: status and ledger rows are system records; the persona asserts none. Reachability: all synchronous, one frozen_time. Prerequisite sentence: four-point test passed (see problem-tree card); state form used; direction affirmative ("only after"), which is how a fee desk states that a charge is fixed only once what it rests on is complete. Rule/compute equivalence: swept both ways (Step 1). Factors: every baseline is exactly what the baseline paragraph states; each of the 12 factors moves the result on this world; near-misses present (06-18 idle line outside the review window, 06-18/06-20 sessions outside the energy window, guest pass not a violation). Draft recomputation from the visible context agrees with gold.

[Rework round 2 — response to audits/policy_task/parking_licenses_and_ev_charging (_difficulty.md, 0.md)]
C-1 (early cancellation compute ignored the end-date gate). Symptom: the rule billed the fee only "when the end date falls before the commitment end", but no binding read the end date (which does not exist in the records before the notice is written). Root cause: a rule condition on a customer-chosen value the compute cannot see. Change: the extended rule now gates on the notice date, a record-visible quantity — "When, at the notice date, the whole months from the license's start date are fewer than the commitment months, an early cancellation fee is billed with the notice; when they are not, no early cancellation fee is billed." — replacing the base end-date sentence (overwrite.replaced_by and baseline.rule updated); compute gains fee_applies = held_months < commitment_months and result = ... if fee_applies else 0, quoted in compute_basis. The base 30-day notice clause on the end date stays inherited. On this world held 3 < 5, so the fee stands at 9.78; all six factor sensitivities (5.00, 21.38, 18.48, 61.96, 18.48, 34.78), the all-baseline 125.00 and the skip-prerequisite 11.93 are unchanged (evalc rerun).
C-2a (idle_session_multiplier mislabelled). Change: effect relabelled parameter, ladder tiers now carry value K('offpeak_multiplier') / K('mixed_multiplier') / 1. The idle computation keeps one honest method factor (idle_hour_counting: completed hours / started half hours / started hours) and now counts 5 parameter + 1 method; figures unchanged (17.62 under its baseline).
O-5 (condition narrower than sentence). The early<-idle condition now reads "stands at its scheduled idle fee, net of any charge reversal credit pointing at it", matching the sentence (policy and prerequisite_closure).
T0-O1 (persona primes a pre-fee step). The reactive line is now generic ("Whatever the agent tells you it is doing on your parking account along the way, you say that's fine"), announcing no pre-fee step.
O-8 (rounding): no scored value or sensitivity figure of this task lands on a half-cent tie under a different reading: 9.1875 -> 9.19, 9.7824 -> 9.78; the tie-shaped baselines 11.375 and 18.375 round to 11.38 and 18.38 under both Python round and half up.
Re-run after the changes: all per-task gates green (see the final gate block in the difficulty report).
user_scenario:
You are Tobias Lindqvist, a thirty-eight-year-old QA lead who has rented apartment 5-318 at Larkspur Bellevue Station in Bellevue, Washington since the summer of 2022. You are calm, a little dry, and you like to get things done in one call. You are phoning Resident Services from your mobile, 425-555-0147, and you open with that number so they can find you. Last weekend you sold your electric car and bought a used gas hatchback, and since the EV Charging Reserved Space in the garage is only for plug-in cars, you want to cancel that parking space. You want October 31, 2026 to be the last day you have it, and you want to know what leaving before the end of the commitment will cost you — you vaguely remember something about an early exit charge in the paperwork but you have no idea of the amount.

What you want today is exactly this: the cancellation of that one EV parking space with October 31, 2026 as its end date, and the early cancellation charge that comes with it. You are not asking for a different parking space, a refund or anything else, and you do not bring up anything else about your account. You understand that a cancellation notice has to be signed by you personally; when the agent sets the notice up and hands it to you, you sign it yourself on the spot, entering the license the agent names, 2026-10-31 as the end date, and the early cancellation fee exactly as the agent states it. Whatever the agent tells you it is doing on your parking account along the way, you say that's fine — you just want the right number at the end.

You only give details when asked. If the agent asks you to confirm your identity, you give the last four digits of your Social Security number, 5281, and if a further detail is needed, your date of birth, March 14, 1988; your email, tobias.lindqvist57@fastmail.com, only if they specifically ask for it. If asked which space it is, it is space 5G-207 in the garage, and the car that was registered on it had the plate 5TKW288. If asked whether you want to keep any other parking, you say no, you'll park the new car on the street for now and don't need anything else. If asked why you are cancelling, you say you sold the EV. You do not know the numbers on your parking account by heart and you do not guess them; if asked about balances or charges you say you'd rather the agent check the records.

When the agent tells you what the early cancellation fee will be, you accept it without arguing — you had expected some charge. Once you have signed the notice and the agent confirms it went through with October 31 as the end date, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identifies the license to cancel and supplies the start date (license held 106 days, 3 whole months), the product (dedicated charger, commitment 6, fee months 1.0) that both computations read.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The standing idle rate factor needs autopay and lease tenure (1538 days); the program share factor needs the rent discount program.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The commitment-by-lease-term factor takes its tier (commitment 5 months) from the current term's length.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Reveals the unmet prerequisite (the 2026-09-12 idle line billed 36.00 with no correction, while the early fee rule says the fee is fixed only after every idle fee line of the three-month window stands at the idle fee schedule amount) and supplies every history input: idle minutes 190, the other idle line of 2026-06-18, window energy 203.45 kWh, session energy periods, fee base window totals and the activation fee.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The fee months standing factor needs the 12-month violation count (0); the guest pass must be recognised as not a violation.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.parking_license_id: a8957827-7699-4fa1-9ccb-64090b56c526. Basis: the parking license lookup returns this license (EV Charging Reserved Space, space 5G-207) as the only license of the customer; the idle fee schedule re-rates 'the idle fee lines of a parking license' and the idle line read from the ledger belongs to it. Uniqueness: the customer holds no other license, so every correct agent passes this id.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_parking_charge_id: 3662588e-349b-4202-a0b9-bc6417b44a3b. Basis: the idle fee schedule rule 'The idle fee line under review is the most recent idle fee line posted on the license within review_window_months months before the handling date; idle fee lines posted earlier stand as billed.' and the parking charges lookup, which returns two idle fee lines: 2026-09-12 (this id) and 2026-06-18 (posted 3 whole months before 2026-09-24, outside the window).
